description: The brand’s posting queues: Default (its posting times) plus named queues, each with its own times per weekday and channels. action list; save (by name: slots = every-day "HH:MM" times, days = per-weekday overrides like {"sat":[],"sun":["11:00"]}, timezone, channels, rename); delete. schedule_post useQueue:"<name>" fills one; set_post_refill queue points autopilot at one. Free.

action.description: preview = the next N free slots, nothing changed

count.description: preview: how many upcoming free slots (1-50, default 5)

days.description: weekday (sun..sat) to times; [] = none that day; null removes the override

name.description: queue name; "Default" is the brand’s posting times

reshuffleExisting.description: save: also move the posts that came FROM this queue onto its new times, in order (posts at an exact time never move)

name: manage_post_queues
title: Posting queues
